ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 85% high-intensity white pixels concentrated in the central lobe regions, contrasted by 15% low-intensity black pixels along the periphery and central focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast black contiguous banding along the entire perimeter; five distinct low-intensity circular focal points arranged in a geometric cluster in the mid-ventral region near the peduncle; linear black streaks radiating from the lower interior edges of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with a sharp interior vertex measuring approximately 60 degrees relative to the horizontal lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; the right lobe exhibits higher amplitude 'sawtooth' peaks, while the left lobe shows more uniform, lower amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Bi-lateral upward sweep with a concave leading edge curve terminating in sharp, tapered distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: A constellation of four distinct, high-contrast dark circular pixel clusters located in the white central field just above the notch vertex.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple non-parallel dark linear disruptions located on the lower medial white regions of both the left and right lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant rectangular/semicircular indentation (tissue loss) on the trailing edge of the right lobe near the distal tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique trapezoidal arrangement of four high-contrast dark dots in the center-white pigmentation field.
